nodes.name: D02 DLQ 조회 입력
nodes.notes: 읽기 전용 조회 입력. 목록은 op=list, scope, limit(선택 1~50), offset(선택 0~10000), 상세는 op=inspect, scope, dlq_id, operator_id를 입력한다. 상태 변경·claim·재처리는 지원하지 않는다.

nodes.name: D05 읽기 전용 DLQ 조회
nodes.notes: Parameterized list/inspect-only dispatcher. Uses a dedicated read-only login; no recovery-operator credential, direct table access, or mutation command.

parameters.jsCode: let raw=$json.result;if(typeof raw==='string'){try{raw=JSON.parse(raw)}catch{raw=null}};const obj=v=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);const op=$('D03 입력 검증').item.json.payload.op;if(op==='list'){const ok=raw?.ok===true&&Array.isArray(raw.items);const safeItems=ok?raw.items.map(d=>({dlq_id:d.dlq_id,request_id:d.request_id,case_id:d.case_id,jira_issue_id:d.jira_issue_id,jira_issue_key:typeof d.jira_issue_key==='string'&&/^JBYS-[0-9]+$/.test(d.jira_issue_key)?d.jira_issue_key:null,failed_step:d.failed_step,error_code:d.error_code,replay_status:d.replay_status,last_execution_id:d.last_execution_id,revision:d.revision,updated_at:d.updated_at})):[];return {json:{ok,operation:'list',scope:raw?.scope??null,limit:raw?.limit??null,offset:raw?.offset??null,has_more:raw?.has_more===true,items:safeItems,error_code:ok?null:(raw?.error_code||'dlq_list_failed')}}};const d=obj(raw)&&obj(raw.dlq)?raw.dlq:null;const s=obj(raw)&&obj(raw.state)?raw.state:null;const ok=raw?.ok===true&&d&&s;const key=ok&&typeof d.jira_issue_key==='string'&&/^JBYS-[0-9]+$/.test(d.jira_issue_key)?d.jira_issue_key:null;return {json:{ok:Boolean(ok),operation:'inspect',error_code:ok?null:(raw?.error_code||'dlq_inspect_failed'),dlq:ok?{dlq_id:d.dlq_id,case_id:d.case_id,failed_step:d.failed_step,error_code:d.error_code,replay_status:d.replay_status,revision:d.revision,last_execution_id:d.last_execution_id,jira_issue_id:d.jira_issue_id,jira_issue_key:key,request_status:s.processing_status,state_revision:s.revision}:null,jira_lookup:{status:key?'pending':(ok?'not_linked':'not_attempted'),issue_key:key}}};

nodes.name: D08 Jira 현재 상태 조회
nodes.notes: Jira API GET only; reads status and assignee display name. No issue update, transition, comment, or assignment request.

parameters.jsCode: const prior=$('D06 inspect 결과 정리').item.json;const code=Number($json.statusCode||0);const issue=$json.body;const fields=issue?.fields;const valid=code===200&&issue?.key===prior.dlq?.jira_issue_key&&fields&&typeof fields==='object';const status=valid&&fields.status?{id:fields.status.id??null,name:fields.status.name??null}:null;const assignee=valid&&fields.assignee?{display_name:fields.assignee.displayName??null}:null;return {json:{...prior,jira_lookup:valid?{status:'found',issue_key:issue.key,issue_status:status,assignee}: {status:code===404?'not_found':'error',issue_key:prior.dlq?.jira_issue_key??null,error_code:code===404?'jira_issue_not_found':'jira_lookup_failed'}}};
